title: CarLife Probe
description: Read-only CarLife environment probe. Shows the root report (processes, open file descriptors, loaded libraries, Cinemo configuration) plus its own port and USB scan on screen for a screenshot. No SSH needed.

zh-CN.title: CarLife 诊断
zh-CN.description: 只读查看 CarLife 的运行环境：进程、打开的文件、加载的库与 Cinemo 配置，连同端口与 USB 扫描结果直接显示在屏幕上，截图即可，无需 SSH
